title: Grade 4 HINDU RELIGIOUS EDUCATION — Termly Exam #11 (Term 2)

pages.quiz:
HINDU RELIGIOUS EDUCATION — TERMLY EXAM #11 (TERM 2)
====

GRADE: Grade 4
SUBJECT: HINDU RELIGIOUS EDUCATION
TIME ALLOWED: 60 minutes
TOTAL MARKS: 50
ASSESSMENT: CBC school-based practice paper

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show your working and write the units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the one best answer.
4. Check your work before you hand in.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. On which festival do many students pray to Saraswati? (1 mark)
   A. Madaraka Day
   B. Vasant Panchami
   C. Paryushan
   D. Maha Shivratri

2. What does Dainik mean? (1 mark)
   A. Monthly
   B. Yearly
   C. Weekly
   D. Daily

3. What is a Mandir? (1 mark)
   A. A river
   B. A Hindu place of worship
   C. A market
   D. A school

4. What does the white colour of Saraswati stand for? (1 mark)
   A. Purity and peace
   B. Heat
   C. Anger
   D. Hunger

5. What does dravinam mean in the prayer? (1 mark)
   A. Knowledge
   B. Mother
   C. Wealth
   D. Prayer

6. When is the Gayatri Mantra a good prayer to say? (1 mark)
   A. Before studying
   B. Only in the night
   C. Never
   D. Only at the market

7. What is the main idea of the Saraswati Vandana? (1 mark)
   A. To ask for knowledge and remove ignorance
   B. To ask for food
   C. To ask for rain
   D. To ask for money

8. What does Saraswati hold in her hands in pictures? (1 mark)
   A. A drum and a flag
   B. A veena and a book
   C. A bow and arrow
   D. A sword and a shield

9. Which is a benefit of praying every day? (1 mark)
   A. It makes homework disappear
   B. It stops all rain
   C. It makes us taller
   D. It teaches discipline

10. Which faith's story in the lesson is about truth and a king? (1 mark)
   A. Hinduism
   B. Sikhism
   C. Buddhism
   D. Jainism

11. Which Jain teaching means not stealing? (1 mark)
   A. Ahimsa
   B. Asteya
   C. Satya
   D. Aparigraha

12. What should you do if you see something online that makes you uncomfortable? (1 mark)
   A. Put it back where you found it
   B. Tell a trusted adult
   C. Share it with friends
   D. Keep clicking

13. How do you show integrity in a test? (1 mark)
   A. Copy from a neighbour
   B. Look in your bag
   C. Do your own work
   D. Whisper answers

14. When getting off a vehicle, what should you do first? (1 mark)
   A. Run
   B. Wait for it to stop
   C. Jump
   D. Stand and push

15. Which two of the Buddha's five precepts appear in the lesson? (1 mark)
   A. Not to sleep and not to eat
   B. Not to steal and not to lie
   C. Not to swim and not to sit
   D. Not to run and not to sing

16. Which is an activity for International Yoga Day? (1 mark)
   A. Doing yoga together at school or a park
   B. Skipping class
   C. Playing loud music
   D. Staying at home only

17. Which is a mistake in yoga practice? (1 mark)
   A. Comparing yourself with others
   B. Following the teacher
   C. Wearing loose clothes
   D. Being calm

18. Where should the hands be in Vajra Asana? (1 mark)
   A. In the air
   B. On the floor in front
   C. On the thighs
   D. Behind the head

19. What does Pranayam mean? (1 mark)
   A. Body posture
   B. Breathing exercise
   C. Song
   D. Prayer

20. Who should guide children in yoga? (1 mark)
   A. Nobody
   B. A stranger
   C. A friend who has never tried
   D. A trained teacher or trusted adult

SECTION B — STRUCTURED / SHORT ANSWERS
----
21. Describe how to do Bhastrika. (3 marks)

22. Describe how the boy in the example story practised Asteya. (3 marks)

23. Describe how to set up a lost and found corner in a classroom. (4 marks)

24. Give three benefits of yoga. (3 marks)

25. Explain what the white colour, the veena and the book stand for in the picture of Saraswati. (3 marks)

26. Explain what the story of King Harishchandra teaches. (3 marks)

27. Explain the Jain teaching called Asteya. (2 marks)

28. Explain the meaning of Kapaal Bhaati. (3 marks)

29. Why should children do Bhastrika and Kapaal Bhaati gently? (2 marks)

30. Why is Saraswati shown with a veena and a book? (2 marks)

31. What does Dainik Prarthana mean? (2 marks)
pages.answers:
HINDU RELIGIOUS EDUCATION — TERMLY EXAM #11 (TERM 2) · MARKING SCHEME
====

SECTION A
----
1. B — Vasant Panchami
   Vasant Panchami honours Saraswati.

2. D — Daily
   Dainik means daily.

3. B — A Hindu place of worship
   A Mandir is a Hindu temple.

4. A — Purity and peace
   White is a sign of purity.

5. C — Wealth
   Dravinam means wealth.

6. A — Before studying
   It is a prayer for wisdom.

7. A — To ask for knowledge and remove ignorance
   It asks for a clear mind.

8. B — A veena and a book
   The veena and the book.

9. D — It teaches discipline
   Doing it regularly teaches discipline.

10. A — Hinduism
   The Harishchandra story.

11. B — Asteya
   Asteya is non-stealing.

12. B — Tell a trusted adult
   A trusted adult can help.

13. C — Do your own work
   Doing your own work is honest.

14. B — Wait for it to stop
   Wait until it has stopped.

15. B — Not to steal and not to lie
   Not stealing and not lying.

16. A — Doing yoga together at school or a park
   People do yoga together.

17. A — Comparing yourself with others
   Yoga is not a competition.

18. C — On the thighs
   Palms on the thighs.

19. B — Breathing exercise
   Pranayam is control of the breath.

20. D — A trained teacher or trusted adult
   An expert can prevent injury.

SECTION B
----
21. (3 marks)
   Answer: Sit tall, breathe in deeply through the nose, breathe out through the nose with the same force, repeat slowly a few times, and rest.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for sitting tall, 1 mark for equal in and out breaths, 1 mark for slow and rest.

22. (3 marks)
   Answer: He found a purse with money, did not keep it, and asked around until he found the owner.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark each for three points.

23. (4 marks)
   Answer: Place a box or table in a safe place, write each item in a book with the date and finder's name, let owners claim their things, and thank those who return items.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark each for four points.

24. (3 marks)
   Answer: It keeps the body flexible and strong, helps us breathe well and stay calm, helps us focus and teaches discipline (any three).
   Working / marking points: 1 mark each.

25. (3 marks)
   Answer: White stands for purity and peace, the veena stands for music and the arts, and the book stands for knowledge.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for each correct meaning.

26. (3 marks)
   Answer: He gave up his kingdom rather than break his promise and never told a lie, so it teaches that truth is worth more than wealth and comfort.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for the promise, 1 mark for truth, 1 mark for the lesson.

27. (2 marks)
   Answer: Not taking what is not given, or not stealing.
   Working / marking points: 2 marks for a correct meaning.

28. (3 marks)
   Answer: Kapaal means forehead and bhaati means shining, so it means shining forehead. The breath goes out in short pushes and breathing in happens by itself.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark each for meaning, quick breath out and automatic breath in.

29. (2 marks)
   Answer: They are active breathing exercises, so children need a teacher and must stop when tired.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark each.

30. (2 marks)
   Answer: The veena stands for music and the arts and the book stands for knowledge.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark each.

31. (2 marks)
   Answer: Daily prayers.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for daily and 1 mark for prayers.
